title: Associate Director, Skincare R&D Process Compliance
location: Irvine, CA, US
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
The Associate Director, Trial Disclosure is responsible for assisting in leading the global strategy for clinical trial data disclosure, management of the operational activities within the Trial Disclosure area. Leads multiple Trial Disclosure disciplines end-to-end, encompassing process and technology strategy implementation, working cross-functionally and meeting required deadlines. Prepares tactical plans (time, systems, databases, and resources) and coordinates related activities. Provides managerial oversight of internal staff member(s) that support global public disclosure of clinical trial data/information in compliance with various requirements/commitments. Develops and maintains strong internal relationships across all levels of the clinical organization, Legal, Public Affairs, Investor Relations, and Regulatory Intelligence to ensure appropriate support and compliance. Forecasts and monitors project timelines and achieves deadlines.
Responsibilities
Provides managerial oversight of staff member(s) that support trial disclosure activities for multiple compounds, including oversight of work products and activities. Accountable for meeting the main objectives projects within established timelines, budgets, and with an appropriate quality level and legal oversight.
Monitors both the US and International regulatory disclosure landscape including trade associations commitments, operationalizing trial disclosure requirements and expectations. Leads the development and implementation of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)/processes, creating efficiency improvements/system automation and communication/training activities. Accountable for the development, implementation, and maintenance of operations related to trial disclosure.
Communicates effectively across functional areas and within department to accomplish project objectives. Ensures appropriate interfaces with all involved functional areas are identified and in place for timely and efficient hand-offs throughout the disclosure process.
Develops expert knowledge of regulations, requirements, policies, and guidelines that apply to trial disclosure , and ensures staff understands, complies, and applies them to work products. Leads the selection, management and oversight of vendor(s) and staff for area and approval of invoices within budgetary spend. Resource, initiate, and manage contract(s)
Monitors and participates in trial disclosure compliance prevention by ensuring that all individuals involved in maintaining compliance have the knowledge and tools required. Escalates issues to management in an expedient manner.
Tracks and monitors trial disclosure metrics. Proactively identify and address and/or escalate issues and opportunities for efficiency.
Implements systems or solutions to enhance efficiency, eliminate redundancy, reduce expenditure, and guarantee quality. Provides leadership for technology change and process improvement.
Ensures projects within operations are driven to timely completion. Must resolve conflicts, remove barriers, and, generate innovative ways to ensure teams achieve required deadlines.
Responsible for creating a culture of process improvement, employee development, performance measures, project prioritization, and developing successful solutions.
Continually trains/is compliant with all current industry requirements as they relate to CTD.
Bachelor’s degree is required. Advanced degree is desirable.
At least 5 years relevant industry experience in quality, regulatory, compliance, clinical research, or drug development. At least 2 years in a disclosure role is preferred.
2-3 years project management experience.
2-3 years experience managing/supervising employees/team(s).
Advanced knowledge of AbbVie organizations, products, processes, and culture preferred.
Demonstrated success in managing broad scope projects involving cross-functional teamwork and in building highly productive teams.
Excellent communication (written and verbal), organization, planning, execution, and team leadership skills are required.
SME with Disclosure and Transparency global regulations for multiple Disclosure disciplines: global registration / results / lay summary / agency disclosure requirements and Access to Data and Information.
Ability to successfully operate in an international environment.

title: Medical Director, Aesthetics Clinical Development
location: Irvine, CA, US
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
As defined in the scope of the assigned development project(s), the Medical Director, Clinical Development will have global responsibilities and fulfill the following roles:
Therapeutic Area Medical Director (TAMD)
With supervision, the Medical Director oversees the planning, execution and interpretation of clinical trials or research activities of a clinical development program. The TAMD participates in cross-functional teams to generate, deliver, and interpret high-quality clinical data supporting overall product medical, scientific and business strategy, all while providing mentorship and guidance to junior team members where needed.
The TAMD may be asked to participate in internal process improvement activities within R&D and the wider organization, as well as external interactions with KOLs and Regulatory authorities.
The employee must conduct their work activities in compliance with all relevant laws, regulations, and regulatory guidelines as well as all AbbVie policies and procedures.
Note: While this job description is intended to be an accurate reflection of the job requirements, management reserves the right to modify, add or remove duties from a particular job and to assign other duties as necessary and at any time.
The TAMD is responsible and accountable for the medical data management of clinical trials, according to applicable SOPs.  The TAMD supports the clinical studies in the Pipeline Commercialization Model, from early development to post-market, including life-cycle management. The TAMD fosters an atmosphere of collaboration, mutual respect, transparent communication, and data driven analyses according to the highest scientific standards and a focus on agility, efficiency and patient-centricity. The TAMD leads the responses for medical and scientific data questions, in collaboration with the TA-SD and other applicable functional and regional input. The TAMD responsibilities include:
With appropriate supervision, manages the design and implementation of study protocols for a clinical development program in support of the overall Product Development Plan, based on strong medical and scientific principles, knowledge of compliance and regulatory requirements, AbbVie’s customers, markets, business operations, and emerging issues. Oversees project-related education of investigators, study site personnel, and AbbVie study staff.
Has responsibility for medical oversight of clinical studies, monitoring overall study integrity, and review, interpretation, and communication of accumulating data pertaining to safety and efficacy of the product.  Along with Clinical Operations, is responsible for oversight of study enrollment and overall timelines for key deliverables.  Responsible for assessment and reporting of serious adverse events per corporate policy and regulations for those protocols on which assigned.
Safety-related responsibilities include but are not limited to: safety coding, safety narratives, overseeing ECG data where applicable, establishing lab alert values where appropriate, chairing and/or participating in a DMC when established for clinical trials, securing and participating in 24/7 medical coverage and checking voicemail for clinical study sites
Escalates relevant safety data review findings to the Product Safety Team
Contributes to design, analysis, interpretation, and reporting of scientific content of protocols, Investigator Brochures, Clinical Study Reports, regulatory submissions and responses, and other program documents.
Presents clinical trial data, especially safety data, related to clinical trials to internal and external stakeholders.
May serve on a Clinical Strategy Team as the clinical representative for the protocols for which the incumbent has responsibility.  Contributes to the development of a rigorous, cross-functionally-aligned, vetted Clinical Development Plan in collaboration with matrix team members.
Participates in opinion leader interactions related to the disease area(s); partners with Medical Affairs, Commercial and other functions in these activities as required, consistent with corporate policies.
Stays abreast of professional information and technology through conferences, medical literature, and other available training, to augment expertise in the therapeutic area.
Responsible for understanding the regulatory requirements related to the clinical studies and global drug/device development and accountable for complying with those requirements. May be asked to contribute to regulatory submissions, responses and discussions, as well as audits and inspections.
Ensures adherence to Good Clinical Practices, pharmacovigilance standards, standard operating procedures and to all other quality standards in conducting research.
Demonstrates initiative and participates in process improvement activities and other strategic or scientific initiatives/projects within R&D and the wider organization.
Medical degree (e.g., MD, DO, MBBS); scientific knowledge and experience in Aesthetics preferred. Completion of a residency program strongly preferred. Completion of a subspecialty fellowship is desirable.
Clinical trial experience in the pharmaceutical/device industry, academia, or equivalent is strongly preferred
Minimum 1 year of experience in medical monitoring of clinical trials an advantage
Ability to run a clinical research study with appropriate supervision
Strong desire and ability to collaborate in a cross-functional setting with different disciplines and across geographies
Knowledge of clinical trial methodology, regulatory and compliance requirements governing clinical trials and experience in the design of study protocols is desirable
Ability to interact externally and internally to support global scientific and business strategy
Track record of successful management of product safety matters (labeling negotiation, etc.) preferred
Experience in preparation of risk management plans, aggregate reports and company core safety information highly desirable
Sound judgment and experience in medical interpretation of safety findings for clinical trials
Working knowledge of MedDRA
Knowledge of basic concepts of statistics and epidemiology
Can work with limited supervision
Advanced analytical skills
Sound organizational and prioritization skills
Basic computer skills (MS Office) and comfortable with AI applications
Must possess excellent oral and written English communication skills
Travel of at least 10% of time, including international travel, may be required

The focus will be on direct selling of products (physician dispensed skincare and skin resurfacing system) and executing pull through programs/events to patients. title: Creative Lead, Design
location: San Francisco, CA
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
The community you will join:
Creative Studio is a multi-disciplinary creative team within Airbnb’s Marketing group, spanning visual design, brand identity, copywriting, art direction, motion and interactive. In partnership with Advertising and Product Design, we are stewards of the brand whose objective is to help current and future Guests and Hosts understand what Airbnb offers, and why it’s meaningful in their lives.
The difference you will make:
We are looking for a Creative Lead who can ensure creative excellence on our Creative Studio team.
Reporting to the Creative Director, and working in partnership with copywriters, product directors, product marketing leads, and business stakeholders, they are responsible for developing creative solutions that define and enhance creative ideas from concept through execution. This role requires strong design expertise, excellent typographic skills, art direction,  and deep understanding of design systems, and brand design.
You'll be entrusted with the Airbnb brand and expected to push forward the way it’s expressed through launch events and materials, brand campaigns, in-product merchandising, product experiences, and other communications. You will be able to translate business and marketing purposes into big ideas that can be executed brilliantly across various initiatives and mediums.
A typical day:
Hands-on execution of world-class communications—from strategy and concept to point and pixel perfect artwork.
Champion the craft of design and visual storytelling, and help elevate them throughout the department’s output.
Partner with Cross functional teammates to ensure the brand’s creative and voice is consistent across all touchpoints.
Collaborate with various departments, producers, program managers, photographers, illustrators, and motion designers to achieve the finished product on time and on budget.
Support external creative and production agencies to execute work that is of the highest quality and consistency.
Champion Airbnb’s mission of connection and belonging at every step. Be a guardian for Airbnb’s values of inclusivity, diversity, and acceptance.
Your expertise:
8+ years experience overall within a creative agency or in-house at a leading brand.
A diverse portfolio of design work showcasing a variety of mediums and roles.
A passion for the craft of their discipline, and for being hands-on with teams and the work.
Strong presentation skills, with an ability to convey complex concepts in compellingly simple terms.
Skilled in multitasking to manage a high volume of creativity and content.
A willingness to collaborate and debate with strong creative thinkers, at all levels, in all corners of the company—from junior creatives to business leads to the CEO.
*A CURRENT PORTFOLIO OF WORK IS REQUIRED FOR EACH APPLICANT*

This role is hybrid and will require the candidate to be based in San Francisco Bay area. The successful candidate will be expected to work from the San Francisco office at least 2-3 days per week.

title: Product Manager, Commerce
location: Culver City, California, USA
description:
About Us
Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.
We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X,  and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.
About the Role
Twitch's Commerce organization drives over $1B+ in annual payouts to creators through innovative monetization products. As we continue to evolve how streamers earn and how communities engage, we're looking for a visionary Product Manager to own the roadmap for supporting streamers through interactive, fun, and mobile-native commerce products.
In this role, you will define and execute the strategy for helping streamers build deeper connections with their communities through interactive features and engaging monetization tools. You'll build solutions for products that help creators monetize (like Bits, Subscriptions, etc) while exploring new ways to help creators earn, engage their audiences, and grow their channels. By focusing on streamer success and community connection, you'll help shape how millions of viewers support their favorite streamers across all devices.
You Will
- Lead the product vision and roadmap for high impact Twitch commerce capabilities, balancing near-term customer and business outcomes with longer-term product investments
- Own the one-to-two year vision & drive prioritization for features that help streamers connect and monetize with viewers, including future innovations in community engagement and creator monetization
- Own core streamer success metrics including interaction rates, creator earnings, viewer engagement, mobile conversion, and retention.
Continuously run experiments to test new features and improve outcomes for streamers and their communities
- Drive multi-screen product strategy, ensuring streamers can engage and monetize their communities seamlessly across devices
- Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Research, and Community teams to deliver products that help streamers succeed and grow their channels
- Champion streamer-first thinking, ensuring all products enhance creator earnings, deepen community bonds, and support channel growth
Perks
- Medical, Dental, Vision & Disability Insurance
- 401(k)
- Maternity & Parental Leave
- Flexible PTO
- Amazon Employee Discount
About the team
Our team is focused on building products that create meaningful value for customers at scale. We operate with a collaborative, builder-oriented mindset where every team member has a voice in shaping what we deliver. We believe in combining rigorous data analysis with creative problem-solving, and we invest in each other's growth through mentorship and open feedback. If you're looking for a team where your ideas translate directly into customer impact and where you'll be supported in taking on ambitious challenges, this is the place for you.
Basic qualifications: - Bachelor's degree
- 3+ years of product management experience
- Experience with live streaming, gaming, or the broader creator economy
- Experience with monetization products and understanding how to balance creator earnings with a consumer experience
- Experience building consumer-facing products at scale, particularly mobile applications or creator/community tools
- Deep understanding of creator ecosystems: their needs, community dynamics, and what helps them succeed on digital platforms
- Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and driving alignment across diverse stakeholder groups
- Experience defining 1-2 year product strategies and executing against ambitious roadmaps
Preferred qualifications: - Familiarity with virtual goods, digital currencies, or in-app purchase systems
- Analytically self-serve: able to write basic SQL, use experimentation/analytics tools and AI tools for product analysis
- Background in social features, chat systems, or real-time interactive experiences
- Personal experience as a content creator or deep engagement with creator communities

title: Sr. Technical Product Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering GTM
location: Austin, Texas, USA
description:
Picture the first product that takes a customer-facing team from "I think this customer needs something" to a delivered outcome that moves a real economic metric. That is what you will own.
You will own the product strategy for the Frontier AI growth organization within AWS Sales and Marketing: the tools, platforms, and experiences that let ProServe, FDE, and partner ProServe teams understand customer challenges, develop tailored solutions fast, and orchestrate delivery. This work directly accelerates AWS's Go-To-Market motion.
This is not a traditional product role. You work at the intersection of engineering, sales, and business development, turning a newly identified customer need into a business outcome. You own the end-to-end experience across three phases: discovery, solution development, and interlock with engineering and business teams so the capability ships.
Picture your week: you define requirements for a customer-needs intelligence tool in the morning, design a solution-development workflow with engineers in the afternoon, and review business-outcome metrics with a GTM leader the next day. You bring product judgment and genuine technical depth, write crisp documents, work backwards from the GTM motion, and make the call when the playbook is being written in real time. You like rolling up your sleeves: prototyping workflows, testing tools, and validating ideas with customer-facing teams before committing engineering resources.
Key job responsibilities
Customer Needs Discovery & Intelligence
- Own the roadmap for tools that help teams understand customer needs, aggregating signals from sales conversations, account data, technical assessments, and engagement history into actionable context
- Define requirements for intelligence experiences that surface what the customer is trying to achieve, what is blocking them, and where Frontier AI teams add the most value
- Drive integration with existing customer data sources (CRM, account plans, support cases, usage telemetry) into a unified view of customer needs
- Enable GTM Strategists and PAEs to convert prospect-level deals into qualified opportunities
Solution Development & Acceleration
- Own the strategy for tools and frameworks that accelerate how customer-facing teams develop solutions, from ideation through prototyping to production-ready deliverables

description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As the first on-the-ground policy lead in Illinois, you will be the tactical architect of our regulatory and legislative strategy in the State, while at the same time prospecting opportunities in eastern RTOs more generally. You will serve as a high-impact advocate who can navigate the Illinois Commerce Commission (ICC) and the state legislature, while promoting our objectives with Illinois utilities and RTOs. You will bridge the gap between our innovative energy technology and the traditional utility landscape, ensuring that our tech and retail electricity solutions are not only compliant but actively shaping the future of the grid.



This will be a hybrid role between Austin and Chicago. At Base, our culture is the heartbeat of our success. We are a tight-knit team that thrives on the energy, spontaneous collaboration, and shared purpose that comes from working side-by-side in Austin. For this role, however, we recognize the unique need to be in Illinois. We will therefore look for a candidate who is committed to having a strong presence both in Austin and in Chicago. If based in Chicago, we will ask you to spend your first four to six weeks in Austin and then approximately one week per month thereafter.



What You’ll Do

 - Lead regulatory advocacy and ICC representation, participating in ICC proceedings, including rate cases, grid-modernization filings, and rulemakings, and becoming the principal point of contact for ICC Staff, Commissioners, and the Citizens Utility Board.

 - Guide the company’s advocacy in the implementation of recent Illinois legislation, SB25, and work with local officials to streamline AHJ requirements.

 - Draft and file petitions, testimonies, and comments that protect our market access and promote tech-forward utility regulations, while monitoring and ensuring company compliance with the Illinois Public Utilities Act and ICC administrative codes.

 - Manage the operational and strategic relationship with utilities and RTOs in Illinois, proactively identifying opportunities and risks, and representing the company in stakeholder proceedings.

 - Work with the broader policy team to develop our positioning in FERC proceedings relevant to our work in Illinois.

 - Act as an advocate for the company at the Illinois State Capitol, and monitor, analyze, and advocate for legislation that impacts our business.

 - Deploy data-driven arguments to persuade regulators and utility partners to adopt flexible, technology-friendly standards.

 - Distill legislative shifts into actionable business intelligence for executive leadership and ensure that our products and processes comply with evolving standards.

 - Identify and partner with trade associations, NGOs, and industry peers to amplify our legislative voice.



What You’ll Bring

 - Significant experience in energy regulatory affairs, with a heavy emphasis on the Illinois market; experience in government affairs is a plus.

 - Proven success negotiating with the ICC and strong familiarity with utilities, RTOs, and the General Assembly in Illinois.

 - Ability to interpret utility tariffs, load profiles, and technical grid requirements, then translate them for non-technical policymakers.

 - Understanding of how FERC rulings impact Illinois-specific energy programs.

 - A strong presence and exceptional public-speaking skills.

 - Ability to run independently to further a surging business.

 - Comfort with challenging the status quo and preconceived notions of what is possible.

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to distill complex concepts into clear, actionable advice.

 - An entrepreneurial mindset that thrives in ambiguity, moves fast, and prioritizes impact.

 - Passion for our work and a commitment to fueling American innovation, security, and prosperity through a more reliable grid for all.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.

Form Energy is hiring an expert-level Jira Administrator to own and evolve our Atlassian platform end-to-end — Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and, over time, Confluence. This is a hands-on, builder's role: you'll be the primary architect of our custom fields, workflows, schemes, and automation rules across a growing multi-project instance, and a trusted advisor to engineering, IT, security, and business teams who depend on Jira to run their work. You'll join as we roll out Jira Service Management more broadly and lay the groundwork for AI-assisted workflows through Rovo and adjacent automation. The ideal candidate has deep, battle-tested Jira administration experience, is comfortable owning complexity rather than avoiding it, and enjoys translating messy business requirements into clean, maintainable configuration.






WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Own the day-to-day administration of Jira Software and Jira Service Management, including project configuration, custom field and field-context design, screen schemes, permission and notification schemes, and issue-type hierarchies — balancing flexibility for individual teams against a sustainable, well-governed instance-wide standard.

 - Build and maintain Jira Automation rules — from simple notifications to multi-step, cross-project automations — to reduce manual work, enforce data quality, and connect Jira to adjacent systems, and troubleshoot automation failures and rule-execution limits as the instance scales.

 - Administer Jira Service Management request types, SLAs, queues, and customer portals, and partner with IT, InfoSec, and business stakeholders to stand up new service desks and continuously improve existing ones.

 - Support integrations between Jira and identity, ITSM, and reporting tools (e.g., SSO/SCIM provisioning, CMDB/asset data, dashboards and reporting for engineering and compliance stakeholders), working closely with IT Engineering & Platforms on the underlying architecture.

 - Act as the subject-matter expert other teams turn to for “can Jira do this?” questions — translating ambiguous requests into clear configuration recommendations, documenting decisions, and maintaining an audit-ready trail of changes to schemes, workflows, and permissions.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - 4+ years administering Jira at an expert level, including hands-on ownership of custom fields, workflows, schemes, and permissions across a multi-project, multi-team instance.

 - Hands-on experience administering Jira Service Management — request types, SLAs, queues, and customer/portal configuration — in addition to Jira Software or Jira Core.

 - Strong practical experience with Jira Automation (or an equivalent tool such as ScriptRunner) and a track record of building rules that hold up in production rather than breaking under edge cases.

 - Comfort working in Jira Cloud administration, including instance-level settings, global permission schemes, and the tradeoffs between project-level flexibility and org-wide standardization.

 - A methodical, documentation-first approach: you can explain why a workflow or scheme is built the way it is, and you leave a clean trail for auditors, teammates, and your future self.
   
   


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Experience administering Confluence (spaces, permissions, templates) alongside Jira in the same organization.

 - Familiarity with Atlassian Assets (formerly Insight) or similar CMDB tooling, and with Rovo or other AI-assisted search/automation features on the Atlassian platform.

title: Director SEC Reporting & Technical Accounting
location: Sunnyvale, CA, US
description:
It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive . As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care , our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion —have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare , you’ll find your purpose here.
Primary Function of Position
The Director, SEC Reporting & Technical Accounting is a highly visible leadership role with direct
responsibility for the credibility, clarity, and integrity of the Company’s external financial reporting.
Reporting to senior finance leadership, this individual leads SEC reporting and technical
accounting, advises executive management on complex and consequential matters, and serves
as a key partner to Investor Relations, Legal, cross-functional finance leaders, external auditors,
and outside counsel. The role offers a meaningful opportunity to shape how a global, innovative
company communicates its performance, accounting judgments, and evolving business model to
investors and other stakeholders. It is also a demanding role: success requires exceptional
technical judgment, disciplined execution, direct and thoughtful communication, and the ability to
remain composed and decisive through compressed filing timelines, significant transactions, and
changing regulatory expectations. The Director will build a high-performing team, strengthen
disclosure and internal-control processes, and create scalable, technology-enabled ways of
working without compromising quality.
Essential Job Duties
• Own the end-to-end preparation, review, and filing of Forms 10-K and 10-Q, earnings
releases, proxy-related financial disclosures, registration statements, and other current
reports. Set a high bar for technical accuracy, narrative clarity, consistency across public
communications, and on-time execution.
• Lead preparation and maintenance of support for the balance sheet, income statement,
statement of cash flows, statement of stockholders’ equity, earnings per share, and share-
based compensation disclosures.
• Translate complex business activity and accounting conclusions into clear, balanced, and
investor-relevant MD&A, financial statement footnotes, and other external and internal
reporting materials.
• Orchestrate a rigorous cross-functional review process with executive management,
Investor Relations, Finance, Legal, external auditors, and outside counsel. Surface issues
early, drive decisions, and resolve comments without sacrificing quality or control
discipline.
• Partner with Investor Relations on quarterly earnings scripts, supporting schedules,
investor presentations, and consistency checks across public communications.
• Oversee and review financial press releases and other public financial information
announcements.
• Lead the analysis and documentation of complex U.S. GAAP and SEC reporting matters.
Develop technically supportable, operationally workable conclusions and communicate
the implications to senior leaders in a direct and understandable way.
• Oversee accounting for share-based compensation, leases, strategic investments,
business combinations, goodwill, intangible assets, and other judgmental or non-routine
transactions.
• Lead implementation and monitoring of new accounting standards, including impact
assessments, implementation plans, policies, controls, disclosures, and cross-functional
communications.
• Own the design and operating effectiveness of internal controls within the function and
support Sarbanes-Oxley compliance.
• Build and sustain a high-performing team through thoughtful hiring, candid coaching,
meaningful development opportunities, clear priorities, and strong accountability. Create
depth and succession readiness across critical responsibilities.
• Redesign reporting and technical accounting workflows using automation, analytics, and
disciplined process improvement. Reduce low-value manual work while preserving
appropriate review, evidence, data integrity, and control ownership.
• Own the SEC reporting calendar, disclosure checklist, tie-out process, review protocols,
and evidence-retention standards, with clear milestones and accountability across
contributors.
• Oversee inline XBRL tagging and filing quality, including taxonomy selection, extensions,
validation, and coordination with the filing service provider.
• Support the Disclosure Committee and Audit Committee through concise summaries of
significant accounting judgments, new standards, filing developments, and key disclosure
matters, including cybersecurity disclosure support.
• Maintain and govern the technical accounting memorandum standards.
• Monitor SEC, FASB, PCAOB, and peer-company developments; assess emerging risks
and recommend timely changes to disclosures, policies, and controls.
• Partner with Business Development, Tax, Treasury, Legal, and business leaders on
transaction structuring and accounting for acquisitions, investments, and other
agreements.
• Establish reporting-process performance indicators, perform post-filing retrospectives, and
implement lessons learned.
• Represent the function with credibility during high-stakes reviews and discussions,
including matters involving executive leadership, the Disclosure Committee, external
auditors, and outside counsel.
Required Skills and Experience
• 14 or more years of progressive public accounting experience or a mix of public
accounting and public-company industry experience, including significant SEC reporting
and technical accounting leadership experience.
• Deep knowledge of U.S. GAAP, SEC reporting requirements, financial statement
presentation, and Sarbanes-Oxley requirements.
• Ability to research complex accounting issues, prepare clear technical memoranda, and
translate conclusions into operational requirements and executive communications.
• Experience leading Forms 10-K and 10-Q and related reporting processes for a large,
complex, or multinational public company.
• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including executive leadership, auditor,
counsel, and cross-functional communication.
• Exceptional analytical, organizational, project-management, and review skills, including
the ability to set priorities, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and deliver
under compressed timelines and sustained scrutiny.
• Recent experience assessing and implementing new accounting pronouncements.
• Leadership grounded in integrity, intellectual honesty, accountability, sound judgment,
and respect. Demonstrated ability to challenge constructively, listen carefully, develop
talent, and make difficult decisions when facts or deadlines require it.
• Demonstrated executive presence and the ability to influence outcomes without relying
solely on formal authority.
• Comfort operating in an environment where the work is visible, deadlines are immovable,
facts may evolve, and the consequences of weak judgment or imprecise communication
can be significant.
• A practical mindset that respects technical requirements while understanding business
objectives, operational realities, and the need for scalable execution.
• Willing and able to work onsite three days per week in Sunnyvale, California.
Required Education and Training
• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.
• Certified Public Accountant credential.
Working Conditions
General office environment. Ability to work at a computer for extended periods and participate in
virtual and in-person meetings. This role carries predictable periods of high intensity. Evening and
weekend work is required during quarter-end, year-end, significant transactions, and SEC filing
deadlines, and unexpected issues may require prompt attention outside normal business hours.
The position requires the resilience and judgment to maintain quality, collaboration, and sound
decision-making during these periods. Ability to travel up to 10%, if required.
Preferred Skills and Experience
• Big Four public accounting experience and experience serving a global, multinational
public company.
• Experience with SAP, Equity Edge Online, and LeaseQuery.
• Experience overseeing SEC filing technology and structured-data requirements, including
Workiva and inline XBRL.
• Experience with Workiva filing controls, SEC taxonomy updates, inline XBRL review, and
disclosure-management workflow design.
• Experience applying artificial intelligence or other emerging technologies within controlled
financial-reporting processes, with appropriate governance and review.
• Experience with automation and analytics tools such as Alteryx, Power Query,
Winshuttle, Automation Anywhere, or comparable platforms.
• Experience accounting for mergers and acquisitions, strategic investments, share-based
compensation, leases, goodwill, and intangible assets.
• Experience presenting significant accounting and reporting matters to an Audit
Committee or Disclosure Committee.
• Experience developing future finance leaders and building teams that can operate with
increasing independence, technical depth, and cross-functional credibility.
• Experience leading through periods of business transformation, including acquisitions,
new business models, systems implementations, or significant changes in reporting
requirements.

title: Research Intern - Machine Learning for Biology and Healthcare
location: United States, Washington, Redmond
description:
Overview
Research Internships at Microsoft provide a dynamic environment for research careers with a network of world-class research labs led by globally-recognized scientists and engineers, who pursue innovation in a range of scientific and technical disciplines to help solve complex challenges in diverse fields, including computing, healthcare, economics, and the environment.
Quine  is a project from Microsoft Research to bring artificial intelligence and experimental research together to accelerate discovery in biomedical science. Central to this effort is a multimodal world model of biology and an interactive harness connecting it to scientific tools, literature, and researchers.
We are seeking Research Interns to join our team based in Redmond, where we study the fundamental machine learning challenges of building a world model of biology and using it in an agentic harness. Our research interests include data-centric machine learning (e.g. scaling laws, data mixtures, information theory, scientific domain adaptation, causal inference), training and evaluation of multimodal generative models, scientific reasoning, agentic systems, recursive self-improvement, interpretability, and artificial intelligence applied to biomedical discovery more broadly.
As a Research Intern within our team, you will have the opportunity to:
Deepen your expertise in multimodal deep learning and contribute to our ambitious research agenda.
Conduct experimentation with world-class computational resources.
Learn in a team with a strong culture of collaboration and rigorous research.
Responsibilities
Research Interns put inquiry and theory into practice. Alongside fellow doctoral candidates and some of the world’s best researchers, Research Interns learn, collaborate, and network for life. Research Interns not only advance their own careers, but they also contribute to exciting research and development strides. During the 12-week internship, Research Interns are paired with mentors and expected to collaborate with other Research Interns and researchers, present findings, and contribute to the vibrant life of the community. Research internships are available in all areas of research, and are offered year-round, though they typically begin in the summer.
Candidates should have demonstrated intellectual curiosity and passion to solve real-world problems in healthcare and life science using machine learning. Responsibilities will include:
Co-development of an internship project in collaboration with the supervisor.
Design, implementation and evaluation of new machine learning methods and models.
Presentation and communication of research findings.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
Currently enrolled in a Doctorate Degree program in Computer Science, Biomedical Informatics, Computational Biology, and other related STEM fields.
Other Requirements
Research Interns are expected to be physically located in their manager’s Microsoft worksite location for the duration of their internship.
In addition to the qualifications below, you’ll need to submit a minimum of two reference letters for this position as well as a cover letter and any relevant work or research samples. After you submit your application, a request for letters may be sent to your list of references on your behalf. Note that reference letters cannot be requested until after you have submitted your application, and furthermore, that they might not be automatically requested for all candidates. You may wish to alert your letter writers in advance, so they will be ready to submit your letter.
Please provide a research statement in your application with one paragraph describing your research aims for the summer program (e.g. areas or topics you would like to work on, potentially group members you would like to work with). We suggest no more than 250 words, excluding citations. Please attach this research statement to the end of your CV at the time of application. Applicants can upload other documents under the “Resume Manager” tab in the top right of the their careers profile.
Preferred Qualifications
Demonstrated ability to develop an original research agenda.
Track record of publication in conferences or journals within machine learning and/or computational biology.
Ability to work and learn in a collaborative and diverse environment.
Experience in one or more of:  Design, training, or evaluation of large unimodal or multimodal transformers, autoregressive models and diffusion models.
Design and evaluation of inference strategies, model harnesses, or agentic systems.
Working with real-world biological or health data.

description:
At  S&C Electric Company,  a 100% employee-owned company, we help keep the lights on for people and businesses worldwide. Our manufacturing roles build the equipment that protects the critical infrastructure of the power grid, and each of our team members lends their unique skills to this crucial mission. We empower our people by providing pathways to a long-term career and support them in their professional growth by sustaining a culture founded on respect, strengthened by collaboration, and measured by our shared successes. The manufacturing industry is booming with opportunities to learn new things, expand your skills, and build a long-term career.
Join S&C to make an impact on tomorrow’s energy challenges and become an employee-owner!
Available Shift
4:30 PM – 1:00 AM (Mon-Friday)
Plus, Overtime as needed.
Compensation
At S&C, we are dedicated to providing competitive and equitable compensation for all our team members, with a commitment to transparency in our pay practices. The starting estimated hourly base pay rate for this position is $27.25 per hour plus 10% shift premium.   This role is also eligible for S&C’s annual short-term incentive bonus, subject to eligibility criteria.
Join Our Team as a Machinist!
The Punch Press Machinist is responsible for operating a variety of Punch Press machines, and manually-controlled equipment, to produce precision parts for S&C products. The Machinist interprets blueprints in order to determine part specifications and uses various machines to craft them. They also complete basic documentation and maintenance tasks to ensure processes run smoothly and move materials when needed.
Key Responsibilities
Operate various manual and Punch Press machines (metal forming, tool and die set-up) to fabricate parts according to standard specifications.
Set up machines with the appropriate materials needed to complete the job.
Interpret blueprints, drawings, and other technical specifications to understand the requirements for basic parts and ensure accurate fabrication.
Perform basic routine maintenance on machines and tools to ensure longevity and quality fabrication, including cleaning and reporting mechanical/electrical issues to department leaders.
Utilize an overhead crane and other material handling equipment to safely position materials for machining.
Complete the first-piece inspection of parts using various measurement tools, confirming that the pieces are the correct material, quality, and specifications before beginning the machining process.
Maintain accurate records of fabrication activities, including tracking the progress of job orders and documenting corrective action needed for the machine, part, or process.
Deburr metal parts using hand and/or power tools, ensuring materials are safe to handle and are in a state that’s ready for further processing.
Mentors basic-level team members in the completion of their work to help their professional growth.
Meet department targets and consistently adhere to quality and safety standards.
Understand and comply with all applicable Company policies and rules.
Additional Functions:
Work with departmental mentors to gain and apply feedback in pursuit of improved work quality and accuracy.
Maintain regular and punctual attendance and adherence to policy.
Communicate effectively and respectfully with others.
Attend in-person or virtual meetings as requested or required.
Other responsibilities as assigned.
Maintain ongoing training requirements.
Flexibility to work overtime when required and as scheduled by management
What you’ll Need To Succeed:
High School diploma/GED
2+ years of hands-on experience operating Punch Press machines
Ability to use hand tools and precision measuring instruments such as scales and calipers.
Good knowledge of machine controls and programs with the ability to setup machines to operate new jobs to specific specifications.
Ability to read blueprints
Ability to work independently and meet requirements of assigned materials requests.
Good communication skills (written and verbal) with the ability to articulate information efficiently and effectively to team members in a variety of production support departments.
Basic computer skills with the ability to review and respond to requests via internal applications.
Basic math skills with the ability to calculate quantities, weights, and measurements.
Good interpersonal and organizational skills with the ability to understand and complete requests given by team member inside and outside of the department.
Ability and willingness to follow Health Safety & Environment procedures accurately, reporting concerns promptly to the safety action team.
Preferred:
1+ year of demonstrated experience with the operation of manual and cutting, and punch press (metal forming) machines.
Major Physical Demands:
Standing: Most tasks are performed in a standing position with intermittent walking.
Lifting: Frequent lifting of items ranging in weight from 5 lbs. to 50 lbs.
Walking: Occasional walking moderate distances
Carrying: Frequent carrying of items ranging in weight from 5 lbs. to 25 lbs.
Pushing: Occasional use of electric hand truck to move parts a moderate distance.
Pulling: Occasional use of electric hand truck to move parts a moderate distance.
Bending: Frequent bending and crouching required to perform a variety of tasks. Reaching
Reaching: Continuous full range of motion from above the shoulders to below the knees.
Handling: Continuous handling of parts ranging in weight from 5 lbs. to 50 lbs., along with a variety of hand-tools.
Other: Most tasks are performed in a standing position with intermittent walking.

title: Account Development Manager, Small Fleet Sales
location: United States of America - Illinois - Chicago
description:
Job Family Group:
Sales Group
Job Description:
The Account Development Manager acquires and activates new small fleet customers. This is a hunter role. The ADM works a defined territory, sells new fleets on our fuel and truck service offering, and stays on each deal until the customer is contracted, set up, and actively fueling. Once fueling begins, the account transfers to an Account Manager for ongoing growth and retention.
Territory and Lead Flow
The Account Development Manager works a zip-code-aligned territory concentrated in a contiguous geographic area. Opportunity comes from two directions: inbound leads routed to the territory, and the ADM's own outbound calling. Both matter, and neither substitutes for the other.
This role requires genuine comfort with cold calling. Inbound leads will not fill the territory on their own, and we are not looking for someone who works exclusively through automated sequences or social outreach. The ADMs who succeed here pick up the phone and talk to people who were not expecting to hear from them.
Core Responsibilities
Acquire new small fleet customers in the assigned territory and meet or exceed assigned goals for closed and activated deals.
Work inbound leads promptly and thoroughly and generate additional opportunity through consistent outbound and cold calling.
Run the full sales cycle: prospect, qualify, pitch, negotiate, and close.
Move closed deals through credit application, contracting, and card setup, working with internal support teams on execution.
Monitor and drive activation on every closed deal. Support is available for the activation process, but the ADM owns the outcome and is responsible for getting the customer fueling.
Understand each prospect's operating model, lanes, and fuel demand well enough to recommend the right programs, products, and card controls.
Execute a clean handoff to the Account Manager once activation requirements are met.
Meet or exceed assigned activity goals, including outbound call volume.
Maintain complete, accurate, and current prospect, pipeline, and activity records in our CRM and sales engagement platforms.
Represent TA credibly to fleet owners and decision makers.
Complete all required compliance and authorization training on time.
Required Skills and Capabilities
Demonstrated comfort and effectiveness with cold calling and sustained outbound telephone selling.
Proven ability to close net-new business against measurable goals.
Persistence and resilience. This role involves rejection and requires someone who keeps dialing.
Ability to drive a deal past signature through to activation without losing momentum.
Strong working proficiency with CRM platforms, sales engagement tools, and Microsoft Office.
Practical fluency with AI and large language model tools, and a willingness to use them to work more effectively.
Strong quantitative aptitude and comfort with volume, margin, and percentage-based analysis.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Preferred Qualifications
College degree preferred.
Five or more years of sales experience preferred.
Business-to-business sales experience preferred, particularly in new business development.
Experience in transportation, trucking, fuel, or a related industry preferred.
Candidates who do not meet every preferred qualification but bring strong new business selling capability are encouraged to apply.
How Performance Is Measured
Performance is measured as percent to goal against assigned targets for closed and activated deals, along with outbound activity and on-time completion of required training. A deal counts when the customer is contracted, set up, and fueling.

Identify, diagnose, and resolve customer issues quickly, coordinating across internal teams to protect the relationship.
Understand each customer's operating model and business needs well enough to recommend the right programs, products, and card controls.
